description: Student Results view migration: create StudentResults.jsx React component, update renderStudentResults() in student.js to a one-liner React mount, replace #view-student-results inner HTML in index.html with a single React mount target. Depends on FEAT-002 (SessionSelector and PreviousSessionPanel must already exist).
steps: Create src/react/components/StudentResults.jsx. This component replaces the vanilla renderStudentResults() function entirely. Imports needed: useState, useEffect from 'react'; Data, Academic from '../../data/index.js'; getCurrentUser from '../../state.js'; gradeLabel, passMark, currentTerm, subjectChip, esc, downloadXlsxMulti from '../../utils.js'; SessionSelector from './SessionSelector.jsx'; PreviousSessionPanel from './PreviousSessionPanel.jsx'; resultsLockedNote from '../../views/shared.js'. IMPORTANT: resultsLockedNote returns an HTML string with a <span> inside it — it is designed for dangerouslySetInnerHTML, so use <td dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: resultsLockedNote(activeTerm) }} colSpan={7} className='muted-cell' /> when rendering the locked row.

StudentResults component body: const currentUser = getCurrentUser(); const sid = currentUser?.studentId; const [selectedSessionId, setSelectedSessionId] = useState(null); const [selectedSessionName, setSelectedSessionName] = useState(null); const session = Data.session(); const [activeTerm, setActiveTerm] = useState(currentTerm()); if (!sid || !Data.student(sid)) return

Modify src/views/student.js: read the file first. At the top of the file, add `import StudentResults from '../react/components/StudentResults.jsx';` alongside the existing imports. Replace the entire body of the renderStudentResults() function (lines ~105 to ~158 in the current file) with a single call: `_reactMount('react-student-results', StudentResults, {});`. Remove the draw() inner function, all termSel references, all visibleTerms logic, and the termSel.onchange assignment. Keep all other functions in the file completely untouched.
